permutation_unit: Participant; labels shuffled within site, shared across 99/96
splitter: Regenerate original stratified split procedure with same seeds for every label vector
null: Labels exchangeable within site; not conditioning on age, sex, motion or protocol
contrasts: DS-minus-Raw/nuisance under label null, NOT tests of equal generalization performance
multiplicity: Holm across 10 one-sided greater tests: 3 scores + 2 contrasts, 2 designs
stopping: Fixed requested budget, no stopping based on significance
